question: What is the Contoso Corp PTO policy?
expected_answer: 20 days of paid time off annually
context: Contoso Corp HR Policy: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually. PTO accrues monthly and may be carried over up to 5 days into the next calendar year.

question: How do I reset my corporate password?
context: IT Security Policy: Employees must reset passwords via the IT self-service portal at portal.contoso.com. Passwords must be at least 14 characters with multi-factor authentication enabled.

question: What is the BYOD policy?
context: BYOD Policy: Bring Your Own Device is permitted for approved device types only. All BYOD devices must enroll in Contoso MDM and comply with encryption requirements.

question: What are the core business hours?
context: Workplace Policy: Core business hours are 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday through Friday. Flexible start times between 7:00 AM and 10:00 AM are available with manager approval.

question: How do I report a security incident?
context: Security Incident Response: Report suspected security incidents immediately to security@contoso.com or call the 24/7 security hotline at ext. 9911. Do not attempt to investigate on your own.

question: What is the remote work policy?
context: Remote Work Policy: Contoso supports hybrid work arrangements. Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with direct manager approval and must maintain core collaboration hours.

question: When are performance reviews conducted?
context: Performance Management: Annual performance reviews are conducted in Q4. Mid-year check-ins occur in Q2. Goals are set during January onboarding meetings.

question: What training is required for new hires?
expected_answer: security awareness and code of conduct
context: Onboarding Requirements: All new hires must complete security awareness training and code of conduct training within the first 30 days of employment.

question: How is expense reimbursement handled?
context: Expense Policy: Submit expense reports through Concur within 30 days of incurring the expense. Receipts are required for amounts over $25.

question: What is the parental leave policy?
context: Benefits Policy: Contoso provides 12 weeks of paid parental leave for qualifying employees. Additional unpaid leave may be available under FMLA.
